In celebration of my favorite board/card game, I have a new video series that introduces players to the Sentinels of the Multiverse characters.

 

Who is it for?  

  • Folks who are new to the Sentinels of the Multiverse

  • Die hard SotM fans that want to correct the various minute mistakes a YouTuber/fellow fan makes

  • Anyone who is interested in learning more about the multitude of Sentinels characters. 

 

What are you doing still reading this, go take a look!  :slightly_smiling_face:

Oh yeah, here's the links...

Dark Watch: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F4j2MyCebog

posts.name: Silverleaf
posts.cooked:
Pydro:
Matchstickman wrote:
...cackling like a madman...
It's strange. You never see anyone complain that this word isn't PC. I wonder why.

I was thinking about this. And I realised that I say the last syllable of the word in a different way to "man". When I say "man" the short "a" phoneme is clear, but when I say "madman" it's almost like that second vowel isn't there and I pretty much end up with "madmn".

So for me it almost doesn't mean "insane male person" in my subconscious because of the way it's pronounced.

That's probably a bit weird, right?
